Subject: WaveTech evidence package — SCIM, SAML samples & RBAC mapping

Elena —

Attached / linked is the package we discussed. Summary of what we delivered and where to look in the bundle:

1) SCIM delta sample (scim-delta-sample-202609.csv) — shows a user lifecycle across create, suspend, and deprovision events; includes timestamps, change_type, prior_state summary, and a hashed user_id column. We can provide JSON if you prefer.

2) SAML assertion examples (saml-assertion-samples.txt) — two assertions (initial login and session refresh). All PII replaced by placeholders; attribute mapping notes included (subject, email, groups, custom:customer_id). We do not persist full assertion payloads beyond short-lived debug captures unless requested and enabled by the customer.

3) RBAC mapping (redwood-access-matrix-v2.xlsx) — concise mapping of roles -> permission buckets -> enforcement layer. Enforcement is two-fold: (a) token-scoped authorization enforced at the runtime API gateway (scope checks), and (b) model-routing/operation checks inside the serving runtime to prevent privilege escalation for admin operations. Each role row includes a short least-privilege rationale and recommended periodic recertification cadence.

Audit & retention: SCIM deltas: default 13 months; assertion metadata: 90 days; access decisions and audit traces: 24 months by default in the enterprise plan (can be shortened for privacy/regulatory needs). If you need retention proof-of-config or a sample log extract from your tenant, we can produce that under an MSA addendum.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A23example (shared with your security group). HubSpot record: HS-89217 for procurement context.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let us know if WaveTech needs the SCIM data in JSON or compressed archive format. If the compliance team wants a short walkthrough of the RBAC matrix we can schedule 30m with Marcus and Soojin.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
